## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test:e2e` pass (from `dist/`)
- [ ] New or changed UI text is in **all six** languages (`node tools/add-strings.mjs`)
- [ ] No new permission, remote code or inline script — or the change is called out here
- [ ] Anything newly recorded is opt-in or documented in `PRIVACY.md` and the site's six privacy cards
- [ ] README / CLAUDE.md updated if behaviour or structure changed (all six READMEs for feature changes)
